title: Database-to-Intelligence Compiler — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Converts structured datasets into searchable knowledge services, validated rules, and specialized AI interfaces. A proposed compiler that turns data into intelligence: structured datasets become searchable knowledge services, validated rules extracted from the data, and specialized AI interfaces that answer questions from the database own records. The paste flags this as one of the five most powerful tools to build first — it converts the network stored knowledge into usable intelligence.
